memory.note: Verified 2026-09-05 on this machine: `gemini --help` lists `--include-directories` (there is no --add-dir), `-y/--yolo`, `-m`, and `--list-sessions` described as 'sessions for the current project'. ~/.gemini/projects.json maps an absolute directory to a project name and ~/.gemini/history holds one directory per project name, so the scoping key is the cwd but the path is not derived from it.
